documents..github/actions/changeset-release-lifecy:
name: Inspect changeset release lifecycle
description: Preserve armed release batches and expose the pinned lifecycle runner.
outputs:
  status:
    description: >-
      mutable, frozen, stale, or unarmed. An unarmed batch still takes content
      updates; it is re-armed only after an automatic dequeue rewrote it, and a
      maintainer's own dequeue fails scheduled and dispatched runs for attention
      while push runs only annotate.
    value: ${{ steps.inspect.outputs.status }}
  may-update:
    description: >-
      'true' when versioning and cleanup may run, meaning nothing is queued and
      the snapshot is current.
    value: ${{ steps.inspect.outputs.may-update }}
  script:
    description: Absolute path to the lifecycle runner for subsequent guarded mutations.
    value: ${{ steps.inspect.outputs.script }}
runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - id: inspect
      shell: bash
      run: |
        node "$GITHUB_ACTION_PATH/lifecycle.mjs" inspect
        printf 'script=%s\n' "$GITHUB_ACTION_PATH/lifecycle.mjs" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
documents..github/actions/sync-cargo-workspace-loc:
name: Sync inherited Cargo workspace versions
description: >-
  Check or repair Cargo.lock versions for workspace members that inherit
  workspace.package.version.

inputs:
  mode:
    description: Use check to report drift or write to repair Cargo.lock.
    required: false
    default: check
  manifest:
    description: Repo-relative path to the root Cargo workspace manifest.
    required: false
    default: Cargo.toml
  lockfile:
    description: Repo-relative path to the workspace Cargo.lock.
    required: false
    default: Cargo.lock

outputs:
  changed:
    description: "true when write mode changed Cargo.lock; false otherwise."
    value: ${{ steps.sync.outputs.changed }}
  packages:
    description: JSON array of inherited workspace package names.
    value: ${{ steps.sync.outputs.packages }}
  script:
    description: Absolute path to the pinned synchronizer for later steps in this job.
    value: ${{ steps.sync.outputs.script }}

runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - name: Sync inherited Cargo workspace versions
      id: sync
      shell: bash
      env:
        SYNC_MODE: ${{ inputs.mode }}
        CARGO_MANIFEST_PATH: ${{ inputs.manifest }}
        CARGO_LOCKFILE_PATH: ${{ inputs.lockfile }}
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        node "$GITHUB_ACTION_PATH/sync.mjs" \
          --mode "$SYNC_MODE" \
          --manifest "$CARGO_MANIFEST_PATH" \
          --lockfile "$CARGO_LOCKFILE_PATH"
        printf 'script=%s\n' "$GITHUB_ACTION_PATH/sync.mjs" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

name: Changeset policy
description: Require valid Changesets entries for release-relevant pull request changes.

inputs:
  release-paths:
    description: Newline-separated Git pathspecs for release-relevant files.
    required: true
  generated-paths:
    description: Newline-separated root-relative pathspecs allowed in the version PR.
    required: true
  package-files:
    description: Newline-separated public package.json files allowed in Changesets entries.
    required: true
  base-ref:
    description: Git ref used as the pull request comparison base.
    required: false
    default: origin/main
  version-file:
    description: Metadata file that must change in a generated version PR.
    required: false
    default: VERSION
  version-branch:
    description: Branch maintained by changesets/action.
    required: false
    default: changeset-release/main
  version-pr-author:
    description: GitHub login of the app that maintains the version PR.
    required: false
    default: "stella-provenance-updater[bot]"

runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - name: Validate changeset policy
      shell: bash
      env:
        BASE_REF: ${{ inputs.base-ref }}
        GENERATED_PATHS: ${{ inputs.generated-paths }}
        HEAD_REF: ${{ github.head_ref }}
        HEAD_REPOSITORY: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name }}
        PACKAGE_FILES: ${{ inputs.package-files }}
        PR_AUTHOR: ${{ github.event.pull_request.user.login }}
        RELEASE_PATHS: ${{ inputs.release-paths }}
        REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
        VERSION_BRANCH: ${{ inputs.version-branch }}
        VERSION_FILE: ${{ inputs.version-file }}
        VERSION_PR_AUTHOR: ${{ inputs.version-pr-author }}
      run: node "$GITHUB_ACTION_PATH/check.mjs"
documents..github/actions/npm-independent-release/:
name: Independent npm release
description: Validate, publish, and finalize independently versioned npm packages.

inputs:
  package-files:
    description: Newline-separated public package.json files to release.
    required: true
  artifact-pattern:
    description: Artifact name pattern containing one tarball per public package.
    required: false
    default: npm-tarball-*
  artifact-run-id:
    description: Optional verified caller run ID whose exact artifacts should be resumed.
    required: false
    default: ""
  artifact-token:
    description: Token with actions read permission for downloading caller artifacts.
    required: true
  dist-tag:
    description: npm dist-tag used for newly published versions.
    required: false
    default: latest
  github-latest-policy:
    description: GitHub Latest policy; preserve, newest-published-stable, or canonical-package.
    required: false
    default: preserve
  github-latest-package:
    description: Canonical npm package promoted by the canonical-package policy.
    required: false
    default: ""
  github-token:
    description: Token with contents write permission for tags and releases.
    required: true
  source-sha:
    description: Immutable caller commit whose manifests and changelogs match the artifacts.
    required: false
    default: ""
  npm-visibility-timeout-minutes:
    description: Minutes to poll the npm registry for published versions before finalize fails. Capped at 45 by this job's fixed timeout-minutes budget.
    required: false
    default: "20"

outputs:
  changed:
    description: Whether the run created or completed release state.
    value: ${{ steps.prepare.outputs.changed }}

runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7.1.0
      with:
        node-version: "22.23.4"
        registry-url: https://registry.npmjs.org

    - name: Install npm for trusted publishing
      shell: bash
      # npm is the pinned publishing client, not a build dependency; lifecycle scripts stay disabled.
      run: npm install --global --ignore-scripts npm@11.11.1 # zizmor: ignore[adhoc-packages]

    - name: Download packed packages
      uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
      with:
        pattern: ${{ inputs.artifact-pattern }}
        path: release-artifacts
        merge-multiple: false
        repository: ${{ github.repository }}
        run-id: ${{ inputs.artifact-run-id || github.run_id }}
        github-token: ${{ inputs.artifact-token }}

    - name: Validate and stage releases
      id: prepare
      shell: bash
      env:
        ARTIFACT_DIRECTORY: release-artifacts
        DIST_TAG: ${{ inputs.dist-tag }}
        GH_TOKEN: ${{ inputs.github-token }}
        GITHUB_LATEST_PACKAGE: ${{ inputs.github-latest-package }}
        GITHUB_LATEST_POLICY: ${{ inputs.github-latest-policy }}
        NPM_VISIBILITY_TIMEOUT_MINUTES: ${{ inputs.npm-visibility-timeout-minutes }}
        PACKAGE_FILES: ${{ inputs.package-files }}
        SOURCE_SHA: ${{ inputs.source-sha }}
      run: node "$GITHUB_ACTION_PATH/prepare.mjs"

    - name: Publish missing versions to npm
      if: steps.prepare.outputs.tarballs != ''
      # Use the hardened publisher from this immutable release-tooling checkout.
      uses: ./.release-tooling/.github/actions/npm-publish-hardened
      with:
        tarballs: ${{ steps.prepare.outputs.tarballs }}
        publish-plan: ${{ steps.prepare.outputs.publish-plan }}
        npm-visibility-timeout-minutes: ${{ inputs.npm-visibility-timeout-minutes }}
        tag: ${{ inputs.dist-tag }}

    - name: Verify npm and publish GitHub releases
      shell: bash
      env:
        ARTIFACT_DIRECTORY: release-artifacts
        GH_TOKEN: ${{ inputs.github-token }}
        GITHUB_LATEST_PACKAGE: ${{ inputs.github-latest-package }}
        GITHUB_LATEST_POLICY: ${{ inputs.github-latest-policy }}
        NPM_VISIBILITY_TIMEOUT_MINUTES: ${{ inputs.npm-visibility-timeout-minutes }}
        PACKAGE_FILES: ${{ inputs.package-files }}
        SOURCE_SHA: ${{ inputs.source-sha }}
      run: node "$GITHUB_ACTION_PATH/finalize.mjs"
documents..github/actions/npm-publish-hardened/act:
name: Hardened npm publish (OIDC + idempotent)
description: >
  Publish a pre-packed npm tarball (.tgz) via OIDC trusted publishing
  with SLSA provenance attestation. Idempotent — skips if the exact
  package@version contained in the tarball is already on the registry.
  Refuses to fall back to NPM_TOKEN auth.

  This action only supports the publish-from-tarball flow: the caller
  is expected to have already run `npm pack` and to upload the exact
  same .tgz to the corresponding GitHub release. The shared tarball is
  the content-addressed link between the GitHub release asset and the
  npm artifact, so downstream users can verify byte-for-byte that what
  they install from npm matches the public reference.

  Caller workflow must declare `permissions: id-token: write` on the
  calling job, and have set up npm CLI v11.5.1+ (which detects the
  GitHub Actions OIDC env vars and performs the token exchange
  automatically).

  One-time per-package configuration is required on the npm side:
  npmjs.com → package settings → Publishing → add a trusted publisher
  pointing at this GitHub repository and workflow path. Without this,
  the action will fail at publish time with a 401.

inputs:
  tarball:
    description: >
      Path to a pre-packed .tgz to publish. Mutually exclusive with
      `tarballs`. One of `tarball` or `tarballs` must be set (both
      are `required: false` because they're alternatives, but the
      action exits 2 if neither is provided).
    required: false
  tarballs:
    description: >
      Newline-separated list of pre-packed .tgz paths to publish in
      order. Each tarball is checked for idempotency (skip if
      `name@version` already on the registry) and published
      independently. The action exits 1 on the first publish failure
      that can't be recovered via the eventual-consistency poll.
      Mutually exclusive with `tarball`; one of the two must be set.
    required: false
  tag:
    description: npm dist-tag for the publish (e.g. latest, next, rc)
    required: false
    default: latest
  publish-plan:
    description: Ordered JSON entries containing name, version, path and planned dependency names. Requires tarballs in the same order; waits for npm visibility after each entry.
    required: false
  npm-visibility-timeout-minutes:
    description: Total visibility budget for the ordered plan in minutes, up to 45.
    required: false
    default: "20"
  expected-name:
    description: Optional exact package name required in a single tarball.
    required: false
  expected-version:
    description: Optional exact package version required in a single tarball.
    required: false

outputs:
  skipped-dependents:
    description: JSON array of transitive dependents skipped after a planned publication or visibility failure.
    value: ${{ steps.publish.outputs.skipped-dependents }}

runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - name: Publish
      id: publish
      shell: bash
      env:
        TARBALL: ${{ inputs.tarball }}
        TARBALLS: ${{ inputs.tarballs }}
        DIST_TAG: ${{ inputs.tag }}
        EXPECTED_NAME: ${{ inputs.expected-name }}
        EXPECTED_VERSION: ${{ inputs.expected-version }}
        PUBLISH_PLAN: ${{ inputs.publish-plan }}
        NPM_VISIBILITY_TIMEOUT_MINUTES: ${{ inputs.npm-visibility-timeout-minutes }}
      # The action owns publication; its runtime invokes the unchanged hardened
      # shell entrypoint with bash -eo pipefail for every planned tarball.
      run: node "${{ github.action_path }}/publish.mjs"
documents..github/actions/signed-commit/action.yml:
name: Signed commit
description: >
  Commit the working tree's changes under `paths` to a branch through the
  GitHub API instead of the git CLI. GitHub signs every commit it creates and
  attributes it to the token's owner (a GitHub App bot, or github-actions[bot]
  for GITHUB_TOKEN), so the commit passes a "require signed commits" rule
  without any key on the runner. Only GitHub-hosted code touches the token.

  `refresh-pr` mode rebuilds `branch` from the checked-out HEAD (the base),
  commits on top of it, and keeps one pull request against `base` open while
  there are changes; when the managed paths match base again, it closes the
  stale pull request and deletes the branch. `append` mode commits on top of
  the checked-out HEAD, which must be the current tip of `branch`; a foreign
  commit on the branch fails the call instead of being built upon.

  Symlinks and submodules cannot travel through the API path and fail the
  step. Large change sets are split into several commits of at most
  `max-commit-bytes` of file content each. The managed paths are left staged
  in the local index.

  The token needs `contents: write`, plus `pull-requests: write` in
  `refresh-pr` mode.

inputs:
  token:
    description: GitHub App installation token or GITHUB_TOKEN that owns the commit.
    required: true
  mode:
    description: "`refresh-pr` or `append` (see the description)."
    required: true
  branch:
    description: Branch that receives the commit.
    required: true
  paths:
    description: Newline-separated git pathspecs; only changes under them are committed.
    required: true
  commit-message:
    description: Commit message; the first line is the headline, the rest the body.
    required: true
  base:
    description: Pull request base branch. Required in `refresh-pr` mode.
    required: false
    default: ""
  pr-title:
    description: Pull request title. Required in `refresh-pr` mode; an open pull request is retitled to it.
    required: false
    default: ""
  pr-body:
    description: Pull request body; an open pull request's body is replaced by it.
    required: false
    default: ""
  max-commit-bytes:
    description: File content bytes per commit before the change set is split into several commits.
    required: false
    default: "20000000"

outputs:
  operation:
    description: >
      `refresh-pr`: `created`, `updated`, `closed`, or `none`.
      `append`: `committed` or `none`.
    value: ${{ steps.commit.outputs.operation }}
  commit-sha:
    description: Tip of the branch after the last commit; empty when nothing was committed.
    value: ${{ steps.commit.outputs.commit-sha }}
  pull-request-number:
    description: Number of the pull request that was created, updated, or closed.
    value: ${{ steps.commit.outputs.pull-request-number }}
  pull-request-url:
    description: URL of the pull request that was created, updated, or closed.
    value: ${{ steps.commit.outputs.pull-request-url }}

runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - name: Commit through the GitHub API
      id: commit
      shell: bash
      env:
        GH_TOKEN: ${{ inputs.token }}
        MODE: ${{ inputs.mode }}
        BRANCH: ${{ inputs.branch }}
        BASE: ${{ inputs.base }}
        PATHS: ${{ inputs.paths }}
        COMMIT_MESSAGE: ${{ inputs.commit-message }}
        PR_TITLE: ${{ inputs.pr-title }}
        PR_BODY: ${{ inputs.pr-body }}
        MAX_COMMIT_BYTES: ${{ inputs.max-commit-bytes }}
        ACTION_PATH: ${{ github.action_path }}
      # `bash <path>` rather than executing the file: the runner does not
      # always preserve the exec bit on action checkouts.
      run: bash -eo pipefail "${{ github.action_path }}/commit.sh"
documents..github/workflows/audit-branch-protectio:
# Reusable workflow: audit branch protection rulesets.
#
# Compares live GitHub rulesets against a checked-in expected
# config and uploads the result as compliance evidence.
#
# Called by individual repos via a thin caller workflow.

name: Audit Branch Protection

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      expected-config-path:
        description: >
          Path to the expected ruleset JSON in the calling repo.
        type: string
        default: .github/branch-protection/ruleset-main.json
    secrets:
      BRANCH_PROTECTION_APP_ID:
        description: GitHub App ID for branch protection
        required: true
      BRANCH_PROTECTION_APP_KEY:
        description: GitHub App private key (PEM)
        required: true

jobs:
  audit:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      contents: read

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v6

      - name: Create GitHub App token
        id: app-token
        uses: actions/create-github-app-token@64ab729a6294000f5aa4a4bc0b73d1f32bc45510 # v3.3.0
        with:
          app-id: ${{ secrets.BRANCH_PROTECTION_APP_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.BRANCH_PROTECTION_APP_KEY }}

      - name: Fetch live rulesets
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}
          REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
        # Custom shell to enable pipefail — the default `bash -e {0}` would
        # let a failing `gh api` upstream of the jq pipe still exit 0
        # because the last command (`jq 'add // []'` over empty stdin)
        # returns `[]` and 0, silently masking auth / rate-limit / 5xx
        # errors and producing a "no drift" false negative.
        shell: bash --noprofile --norc -eo pipefail {0}
        run: |
          # gh CLI no longer permits --slurp with --jq (mutually exclusive
          # since v2.59). Pipe to jq instead to keep the original "flatten
          # paginated array pages, default to []" semantics intact.
          gh api "repos/${REPO}/rulesets" \
            --paginate \
            --slurp \
            | jq 'add // []' > live-rulesets.json

          echo "::group::Live rulesets"
          jq . live-rulesets.json
          echo "::endgroup::"

      - name: Drift detection
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}
          REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
          EXPECTED_PATH: ${{ inputs.expected-config-path }}
        # Same pipefail rationale as `Fetch live rulesets`: the gh api
        # → jq pipeline must surface upstream failures.
        shell: bash --noprofile --norc -eo pipefail {0}
        run: |
          if [ ! -f "${EXPECTED_PATH}" ]; then
            echo "::error::Expected config not found: ${EXPECTED_PATH}"
            exit 1
          fi

          EXPECTED_NAME=$(jq -r '.name' "${EXPECTED_PATH}")
          echo "Looking for ruleset: ${EXPECTED_NAME}"

          # Match by name on the list endpoint to resolve the ruleset ID.
          MATCHED_ID=$(jq --arg name "${EXPECTED_NAME}" \
            '.[] | select(.name == $name) | .id' \
            live-rulesets.json)

          if [ -z "${MATCHED_ID}" ]; then
            echo "::error::Ruleset '${EXPECTED_NAME}' not found on GitHub."
            {
              echo "DRIFT_DETECTED=true"
              echo "EXPECTED_NAME=${EXPECTED_NAME}"
            } >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
            exit 0
          fi

          # The list endpoint returns only summary fields (id, name, target,
          # enforcement, source, *_at). conditions / bypass_actors / rules
          # are only on the per-ruleset detail endpoint — without this
          # fetch, drift detection compares against nulls and always
          # reports drift.
          gh api "repos/${REPO}/rulesets/${MATCHED_ID}" > live-matched.json

          echo "::group::Live ruleset (detail)"
          jq . live-matched.json
          echo "::endgroup::"

          # Normalize both inputs before comparison. The API returns
          # server-managed metadata, may reorder set-like arrays, and may
          # materialize optional settings at their disabled defaults.
          # Canonicalizing those representations avoids false drift while
          # preserving differences in effective protection policy.
          NORMALIZE_RULESET_FILTER='
            def sort_arrays:
              walk(if type == "array" then sort else . end);

            {
              name,
              target,
              enforcement,
              conditions,
              bypass_actors,
              rules
            }
            | .rules |= map(
                if .type == "pull_request" then
                  .parameters.dismissal_restriction //= {
                    allowed_actors: [],
                    enabled: false
                  }
                else
                  .
                end
              )
            | sort_arrays
          '

          jq -S "${NORMALIZE_RULESET_FILTER}" \
            "${EXPECTED_PATH}" > expected-normalized.json
          jq -S "${NORMALIZE_RULESET_FILTER}" \
            live-matched.json > live-normalized.json

          if diff expected-normalized.json live-normalized.json > drift.diff; then
            echo "No drift detected."
            DRIFT=false
          else
            echo "::warning::Drift detected in ruleset '${EXPECTED_NAME}'."
            echo "::group::Diff (expected vs live)"
            cat drift.diff
            echo "::endgroup::"
            DRIFT=true
          fi

          # actions/upload-artifact rejects names containing any of:
          #   / \ : * ? " < > | and newlines.
          # Ruleset names can legitimately contain ref patterns like
          # `release/*` or `feature:hotfix`, so the raw name is not safe
          # as an artifact suffix. Slug it down to [A-Za-z0-9._-].
          EXPECTED_SLUG=$(printf '%s' "${EXPECTED_NAME}" | tr -c '[:alnum:]._-' '_')

          {
            echo "DRIFT_DETECTED=${DRIFT}"
            echo "EXPECTED_NAME=${EXPECTED_NAME}"
            echo "EXPECTED_SLUG=${EXPECTED_SLUG}"
          } >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Prepare evidence
        run: |
          mkdir -p evidence
          TIMESTAMP=$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
          REPO="${{ github.repository }}"

          jq -n \
            --arg repo "${REPO}" \
            --arg ts "${TIMESTAMP}" \
            --arg sha "${{ github.sha }}" \
            --arg run "${{ github.run_id }}" \
            --arg drift "${DRIFT_DETECTED}" \
            --slurpfile live live-rulesets.json \
            '{
              repository: $repo,
              timestamp: $ts,
              commit_sha: $sha,
              workflow_run_id: $run,
              drift_detected: ($drift == "true"),
              live_rulesets: $live[0]
            }' > evidence/branch-protection-audit.json

          if [ -f drift.diff ]; then
            cp drift.diff evidence/
          fi

          echo "::group::Evidence"
          cat evidence/branch-protection-audit.json | jq .
          echo "::endgroup::"

      - name: Upload evidence
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          # Include the ruleset slug so parallel callers (one job per
          # expected ruleset) don't collide on a shared run_id.
          # EXPECTED_SLUG is the ruleset name with disallowed artifact-
          # name characters (e.g. `/`, `:`, `*`) replaced.
          name: branch-protection-evidence-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ env.EXPECTED_SLUG }}
          path: evidence/
          retention-days: 365

      - name: Fail on drift
        if: env.DRIFT_DETECTED == 'true'
        run: |
          echo "::error::Branch protection drift detected. Review the evidence artifact."
          exit 1
documents..github/workflows/changeset-release-pr.y:
name: Changeset release PR

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      runs-on:
        description: "Runner labels as a JSON array"
        required: false
        type: string
        default: '["ubuntu-latest"]'
      bun-version-file:
        description: package.json containing the Bun version used by the repository.
        required: false
        type: string
        default: package.json
      title:
        description: Version PR title.
        required: false
        type: string
        default: "chore: version packages"
      commit:
        description: Version PR commit message.
        required: false
        type: string
        default: "chore: version packages"
      auto-merge-command:
        description: >-
          Optional repository-owned merge gate. RELEASE_PR_NUMBER identifies the
          current release PR. Must enforce required checks and pin the PR head.
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
      sync-cargo-inherited-lock:
        description: >-
          Validate and synchronize Cargo.lock entries for workspace packages
          that inherit workspace.package.version.
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false
      cargo-manifest:
        description: Repo-relative root Cargo workspace manifest.
        required: false
        type: string
        default: Cargo.toml
      cargo-lockfile:
        description: Repo-relative Cargo lockfile.
        required: false
        type: string
        default: Cargo.lock
      prepare-rust-wasm:
        description: >-
          Install the wasm32-unknown-unknown target and the wasm-bindgen CLI
          version resolved by the locked Cargo workspace before versioning.
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false
    secrets:
      CHANGELOG_APP_ID:
        description: GitHub App ID used to maintain the version PR.
        required: true
      CHANGELOG_APP_PRIVATE_KEY:
        description: GitHub App private key used to maintain the version PR.
        required: true

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read
  checks: read

jobs:
  version:
    name: Maintain version packages PR
    env:
      RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN: 1.99.1
    runs-on: ${{ fromJSON(inputs.runs-on) }}
    timeout-minutes: 15
    concurrency:
      group: changeset-release-pr-${{ github.ref }}
      cancel-in-progress: false
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7.1.0
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          package-manager-cache: false

      - name: Inspect release lifecycle
        id: lifecycle
        uses: stella/.github/.github/actions/changeset-release-lifecycle@636b7841096c8f0cc5a1572077b78768ef8fea42
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}

      - if: steps.lifecycle.outputs.may-update == 'true'
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@0c5077e51419868618aeaa5fe8019c62421857d6 # v2
        with:
          bun-version-file: ${{ inputs.bun-version-file }}

      - if: steps.lifecycle.outputs.may-update == 'true'
        run: bun install --frozen-lockfile

      - if: steps.lifecycle.outputs.may-update == 'true' && (inputs.sync-cargo-inherited-lock || inputs.prepare-rust-wasm)
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@b725eda525362e7cf34af9a7243cac1e3f01a7ec
        with:
          toolchain: 1.99.1

      # rust-toolchain only prepends the toolchain when it installs one. Keep
      # Cargo available when the runner already has the requested toolchain.
      - if: steps.lifecycle.outputs.may-update == 'true' && (inputs.sync-cargo-inherited-lock || inputs.prepare-rust-wasm)
        name: Add Cargo to PATH
        run: echo "$HOME/.cargo/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

      - if: steps.lifecycle.outputs.may-update == 'true' && inputs.prepare-rust-wasm
        name: Prepare locked Rust Wasm toolchain
        shell: bash
        env:
          CARGO_MANIFEST_PATH: ${{ inputs.cargo-manifest }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          rustup target add wasm32-unknown-unknown --toolchain 1.99.1

          mapfile -t versions < <(
            cargo metadata \
              --locked \
              --manifest-path "$CARGO_MANIFEST_PATH" \
              --format-version 1 \
              --all-features \
              | jq -r '[.packages[] | select(.name == "wasm-bindgen") | .version] | unique | .[]'
          )
          if [[ "${#versions[@]}" -ne 1 ]]; then
            echo "::error::Expected exactly one locked wasm-bindgen version; found: ${versions[*]:-none}"
            exit 1
          fi
          cargo install wasm-bindgen-cli --version "${versions[0]}" --locked

      - if: steps.lifecycle.outputs.may-update == 'true' && inputs.sync-cargo-inherited-lock
        name: Validate inherited Cargo lock versions
        id: cargo-sync
        uses: stella/.github/.github/actions/sync-cargo-workspace-lock@636b7841096c8f0cc5a1572077b78768ef8fea42
        with:
          mode: check
          manifest: ${{ inputs.cargo-manifest }}
          lockfile: ${{ inputs.cargo-lockfile }}

      - if: steps.lifecycle.outputs.may-update == 'true'
        name: Prepare version command
        id: version-command
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          version_command="$RUNNER_TEMP/stella-changeset-version.sh"
          cat > "$version_command" <<'EOF'
          #!/usr/bin/env bash
          set -euo pipefail

          bun run changeset:version
          if [[ "$SYNC_CARGO_INHERITED_LOCK" == "true" ]]; then
            if [[ -z "$CARGO_SYNC_SCRIPT" ]]; then
              echo "::error::Cargo synchronizer path is unavailable"
              exit 1
            fi
            node "$CARGO_SYNC_SCRIPT" \
              --mode write \
              --manifest "$CARGO_MANIFEST_PATH" \
              --lockfile "$CARGO_LOCKFILE_PATH"
          fi
          EOF
          chmod 0700 "$version_command"
          printf 'path=%s\n' "$version_command" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      # Install hooks run before a write-capable credential exists in the job.
      - if: steps.lifecycle.outputs.may-update == 'true'
        name: Mint version PR token
        id: app-token
        uses: actions/create-github-app-token@64ab729a6294000f5aa4a4bc0b73d1f32bc45510 # v3.3.0
        with:
          client-id: ${{ secrets.CHANGELOG_APP_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.CHANGELOG_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          owner: ${{ github.repository_owner }}
          repositories: ${{ github.event.repository.name }}
          permission-contents: write
          permission-pull-requests: write

      # Run the pinned upstream entrypoint under a wrapper so only GitHub's
      # queue-lock rejection becomes a deferral. Other failures stay red.
      - if: steps.lifecycle.outputs.may-update == 'true'
        name: Fetch Changesets action
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          repository: changesets/action
          ref: 8488615a623b1b9c987934bb89eae8af6a946ac1 # v2.1.1
          path: .changesets-action
          persist-credentials: false

      - if: steps.lifecycle.outputs.may-update == 'true'
        name: Isolate Changesets action from release contents
        id: changesets-runtime
        run: |
          action_path="$RUNNER_TEMP/changesets-action-$GITHUB_RUN_ID-$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT"
          mv .changesets-action "$action_path"
          printf 'entrypoint=%s\n' "$action_path/dist/index.js" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - if: steps.lifecycle.outputs.may-update == 'true'
        name: Create or update version packages PR
        id: changesets
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}
          LIFECYCLE_SCRIPT: ${{ steps.lifecycle.outputs.script }}
          CHANGESETS_ENTRYPOINT: ${{ steps.changesets-runtime.outputs.entrypoint }}
          INPUT_GITHUB-TOKEN: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}
          INPUT_VERSION-SCRIPT: bash ${{ steps.version-command.outputs.path }}
          INPUT_PR-TITLE: ${{ inputs.title }}
          INPUT_COMMIT-MESSAGE: ${{ inputs.commit }}
          INPUT_CREATE-GITHUB-RELEASES: 'true'
          INPUT_PUSH-GIT-TAGS: 'true'
          INPUT_PUSH-WITH-GIT-CLI: 'false'
          CARGO_LOCKFILE_PATH: ${{ inputs.cargo-lockfile }}
          CARGO_MANIFEST_PATH: ${{ inputs.cargo-manifest }}
          CARGO_SYNC_SCRIPT: ${{ steps.cargo-sync.outputs.script }}
          SYNC_CARGO_INHERITED_LOCK: ${{ inputs.sync-cargo-inherited-lock }}
        run: node "$LIFECYCLE_SCRIPT" version

      - if: >-
          steps.changesets.outputs.may-update == 'true' &&
          steps.changesets.outputs.pr-number == ''
        name: Remove stale version packages PR
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}
          LIFECYCLE_SCRIPT: ${{ steps.lifecycle.outputs.script }}
        run: node "$LIFECYCLE_SCRIPT" cleanup

      - if: >-
          steps.changesets.outputs.may-update == 'true' &&
          steps.changesets.outputs.pr-number != '' && inputs.auto-merge-command != ''
        name: Hand release PR to the repository merge gate
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}
          GH_READ_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          LIFECYCLE_SCRIPT: ${{ steps.lifecycle.outputs.script }}
          RELEASE_MERGE_COMMAND: ${{ inputs.auto-merge-command }}
        run: node "$LIFECYCLE_SCRIPT" merge
documents..github/workflows/label-sync.yml:
# Reusable workflow: apply labels.yml to the calling repository.
#
# A repo opts in with a thin caller workflow. Each run uses that repo's own
# GITHUB_TOKEN, so no credential is stored anywhere and nothing can write
# outside the repository that invoked it.
#
# The manifest is read from stella/.github, which is public, so fetching it
# needs no authentication.

name: Label Sync

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      mode:
        description: plan, apply, or apply-with-prune
        type: string
        default: plan
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      mode:
        description: What the run is allowed to do
        type: choice
        default: plan
        options:
          - plan
          - apply
          - apply-with-prune

jobs:
  sync:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: read
      issues: write

    steps:
      - name: Check out the label manifest
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v6
        with:
          repository: ${{ github.repository_owner }}/.github
          sparse-checkout: |
            labels.yml
            labels/
            scripts/sync-labels.sh
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false

      - name: Sync labels
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          MODE: ${{ inputs.mode || 'plan' }}
          TARGET: ${{ github.repository }}
        run: bash scripts/sync-labels.sh "$MODE" "$TARGET" | tee "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
documents..github/workflows/npm-independent-releas:
name: Independent npm release

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      package-files:
        description: Newline-separated public package.json files to release.
        required: true
        type: string
      artifact-pattern:
        description: Artifact name pattern containing one tarball per public package.
        required: false
        type: string
        default: npm-tarball-*
      artifact-run-id:
        description: Optional caller run ID whose exact package artifacts should be resumed.
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ""
      dist-tag:
        description: npm dist-tag used for newly published versions.
        required: false
        type: string
        default: latest
      github-latest-policy:
        description: GitHub Latest policy; preserve, newest-published-stable, or canonical-package.
        required: false
        type: string
        default: preserve
      github-latest-package:
        description: Canonical npm package promoted by the canonical-package policy.
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ""
      source-ref:
        description: Optional caller commit or ref whose manifests and changelogs match the artifacts.
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ""
      npm-visibility-timeout-minutes:
        description: Minutes to poll the npm registry for published versions before finalize fails. Capped at 45 by this job's fixed timeout-minutes budget.
        required: false
        type: number
        default: 20
      environment:
        description: Optional caller environment holding the release App credentials; empty runs the job without one.
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ""
    outputs:
      changed:
        description: Whether the run created or completed release state.
        value: ${{ jobs.release.outputs.changed }}
    secrets:
      RELEASE_APP_ID:
        description: Optional GitHub App ID for protected tag and release writes.
        required: false
      RELEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY:
        description: Optional GitHub App private key for protected tag and release writes.
        required: false

permissions: {}

jobs:
  release:
    name: Publish packages
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Fixed budget: GitHub Actions cannot set this from an input. Keep it
    # above the maximum accepted npm-visibility-timeout-minutes (45, see
    # MAX_NPM_VISIBILITY_TIMEOUT_MINUTES in runtime.mjs) plus margin for
    # checkout, staging, and the npm publish steps that run first.
    timeout-minutes: 55
    # Lets a caller keep RELEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY as an environment secret whose
    # deployment policy limits the refs that can mint the token; an empty
    # name runs without an environment.
    environment: ${{ inputs.environment }}
    permissions:
      actions: read # Download exact artifacts from a verified recovery run.
      contents: write # Create immutable package tags and GitHub releases.
      id-token: write # Exchange a short-lived npm trusted-publishing credential.
    outputs:
      changed: ${{ steps.release.outputs.changed }}
    env:
      HAS_RELEASE_APP_CREDENTIALS: >-
        ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_ID != ''
            && secrets.RELEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY != '' }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v6
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
          ref: ${{ inputs.source-ref || github.sha }}

      - name: Resolve immutable release source
        id: source
        shell: bash
        run: echo "sha=$(git rev-parse HEAD)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      # The job identity points at the called reusable workflow, unlike the
      # top-level github context, which describes the caller. Check out the
      # exact called-workflow commit so its action implementation cannot drift.
      - name: Checkout release tooling
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v6
        with:
          repository: ${{ job.workflow_repository }}
          ref: ${{ job.workflow_sha }}
          path: .release-tooling
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Verify recovery artifact source
        if: inputs.artifact-run-id != ''
        shell: bash
        env:
          ARTIFACT_RUN_ID: ${{ inputs.artifact-run-id }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          SOURCE_SHA: ${{ steps.source.outputs.sha }}
        run: node .release-tooling/.github/actions/npm-independent-release/verify-artifact-run.mjs

      - name: Mint release token
        id: release-token
        if: env.HAS_RELEASE_APP_CREDENTIALS == 'true'
        uses: actions/create-github-app-token@64ab729a6294000f5aa4a4bc0b73d1f32bc45510 # v3.3.0
        with:
          client-id: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          owner: ${{ github.repository_owner }}
          repositories: ${{ github.event.repository.name }}
          permission-contents: write

      - name: Release independently versioned packages
        id: release
        uses: ./.release-tooling/.github/actions/npm-independent-release
        with:
          package-files: ${{ inputs.package-files }}
          artifact-pattern: ${{ inputs.artifact-pattern }}
          artifact-run-id: ${{ inputs.artifact-run-id }}
          artifact-token: ${{ github.token }}
          dist-tag: ${{ inputs.dist-tag }}
          github-latest-package: ${{ inputs.github-latest-package }}
          github-latest-policy: ${{ inputs.github-latest-policy }}
          github-token: ${{ steps.release-token.outputs.token || github.token }}
          npm-visibility-timeout-minutes: ${{ inputs.npm-visibility-timeout-minutes }}
          source-sha: ${{ steps.source.outputs.sha }}
documents..github/workflows/pr-lint.yml:
name: PR Lint (Reusable)

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      runs-on:
        description: 'Runner to use (default: ubuntu-latest)'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: '"ubuntu-latest"'

jobs:
  pr-lint:
    # Skip if this is a body-only edit (no title change)
    if: github.event.action != 'edited' || github.event.changes.title
    runs-on: ${{ fromJSON(inputs.runs-on) }}
    timeout-minutes: 10
    continue-on-error: true
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: write
      issues: read
    steps:
      - name: PR Conventional Commit Validation
        uses: ytanikin/PRConventionalCommits@b628c5a234cc32513014b7bfdd1e47b532124d98  # 1.3.0
        with:
          task_types: '["feat","fix","docs","refactor","chore","perf","test","ci"]'
          custom_labels: '{"feat": "enhancement", "fix": "bug", "refactor": "enhancement"}'

      - name: copy-issue-labels
        uses: michalvankodev/copy-issue-labels@c4df96ee53d2cdf639ba169a26c43b04d5085cb3  # 2023-09-12
        with:
          repo-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: size-label
        uses: pascalgn/size-label-action@56b489b027932ec0cf60438a1a5f1a19c8fc71ff  # v0.5.7
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: auto-assign
        uses: kentaro-m/auto-assign-action@0a2c53d3721e4c5cfcce6afd4014aecc337979f6  # v2.0.2
        with:
          configuration-path: ".github/assign_config.yml"
documents..github/workflows/provenance-update.yml:
name: Provenance Update

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      root:
        description: "Repository root to scan"
        required: false
        type: string
        default: "."
      node-version:
        description: "Node.js version used to install cdxgen"
        required: false
        type: string
        default: "22"
      cdxgen-version:
        description: "Pinned @cyclonedx/cdxgen version"
        required: false
        type: string
        default: "12.1.5"
      install-syft:
        description: "Whether to install Syft for container provenance generation"
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false
      syft-version:
        description: "Pinned Syft release tag"
        required: false
        type: string
        default: "v1.42.4"
      provenance-version:
        description: "GitHub release tag in stella/provenance to install"
        required: false
        type: string
        default: "v0.1.3"
      provenance-repository:
        description: "Repository that hosts the provenance CLI"
        required: false
        type: string
        default: "stella/provenance"
      install-command:
        description: "Optional repository install command to run before provenance generate"
        required: false
        type: string
        default: "bun install --frozen-lockfile"
      branch:
        description: "Branch name used for provenance refresh PRs"
        required: false
        type: string
        default: "chore/provenance-update"
      commit-message:
        description: "Commit message for generated provenance updates"
        required: false
        type: string
        default: "chore: refresh provenance artifacts"
      pr-title:
        description: "Pull request title for generated provenance updates"
        required: false
        type: string
        default: "chore: refresh provenance artifacts"
      pr-body:
        description: "Pull request body for generated provenance updates"
        required: false
        type: string
        default: "Automated provenance refresh generated by the shared nightly updater."
    secrets:
      auth_token:
        description: "Optional token that owns the refresh commit and pull request (a PAT or App token lets the PR trigger downstream CI)"
        required: false
      app_id:
        description: "Optional GitHub App ID used to mint a token inside this workflow"
        required: false
      app_private_key:
        description: "Optional GitHub App private key used to mint a token inside this workflow"
        required: false

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  update:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    env:
      HAS_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.auth_token != '' }}
      HAS_APP_CREDENTIALS: >-
        ${{ secrets.app_id != ''
            && secrets.app_private_key != '' }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v6
        with:
          # The commit goes through the API, so no credential needs to reach
          # disk or the generators below.
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7.1.0
        with:
          node-version: ${{ inputs.node-version }}

      - name: Setup Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@0c5077e51419868618aeaa5fe8019c62421857d6 # v2

      - name: Install cdxgen
        shell: bash
        env:
          CDXGEN_VERSION: ${{ inputs.cdxgen-version }}
        run: |
          case "$CDXGEN_VERSION" in
            ''|*[!A-Za-z0-9._-]*)
              echo "::error::Invalid cdxgen-version input: $CDXGEN_VERSION"
              exit 1
              ;;
          esac
          npm install --global "@cyclonedx/cdxgen@$CDXGEN_VERSION"

      - id: syft
        if: inputs.install-syft
        uses: anchore/sbom-action/download-syft@66cbf4bc1f1c0d2edc94016e65bc221b6bb0ad6c # v0.24.3
        with:
          syft-version: ${{ inputs.syft-version }}

      - name: Install provenance
        shell: bash
        env:
          PROVENANCE_REPOSITORY: ${{ inputs.provenance-repository }}
          PROVENANCE_VERSION: ${{ inputs.provenance-version }}
        run: |
          case "$PROVENANCE_REPOSITORY" in
            ''|*[!A-Za-z0-9._/-]*)
              echo "::error::Invalid provenance-repository input: $PROVENANCE_REPOSITORY"
              exit 1
              ;;
          esac
          case "$PROVENANCE_VERSION" in
            ''|*[!A-Za-z0-9._/-]*)
              echo "::error::Invalid provenance-version input: $PROVENANCE_VERSION"
              exit 1
              ;;
          esac
          case "${RUNNER_OS}:${RUNNER_ARCH}" in
            Linux:X64)
              target="x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu"
              asset_ext="tar.gz"
              binary_name="provenance"
              ;;
            macOS:ARM64)
              target="aarch64-apple-darwin"
              asset_ext="tar.gz"
              binary_name="provenance"
              ;;
            macOS:X64)
              target="x86_64-apple-darwin"
              asset_ext="tar.gz"
              binary_name="provenance"
              ;;
            Windows:X64)
              target="x86_64-pc-windows-msvc"
              asset_ext="zip"
              binary_name="provenance.exe"
              ;;
            *)
              echo "::error::Unsupported runner platform: ${RUNNER_OS}:${RUNNER_ARCH}"
              exit 1
              ;;
          esac

          asset_name="provenance-${PROVENANCE_VERSION}-${target}.${asset_ext}"
          checksums_name="provenance-${PROVENANCE_VERSION}-checksums.txt"
          release_base_url="https://github.com/${PROVENANCE_REPOSITORY}/releases/download/${PROVENANCE_VERSION}"
          asset_path="${RUNNER_TEMP}/${asset_name}"
          checksums_path="${RUNNER_TEMP}/${checksums_name}"
          install_root="${RUNNER_TEMP}/provenance-install"
          install_bin="${RUNNER_TEMP}/provenance-bin"

          curl --fail --silent --show-error --location \
            --output "$asset_path" \
            "${release_base_url}/${asset_name}"
          curl --fail --silent --show-error --location \
            --output "$checksums_path" \
            "${release_base_url}/${checksums_name}"

          expected_checksum="$(
            awk -v asset="$asset_name" '$2 == asset { print $1 }' "$checksums_path"
          )"
          if [ -z "$expected_checksum" ]; then
            echo "::error::Checksum for ${asset_name} not found in ${checksums_name}"
            exit 1
          fi

          if command -v sha256sum >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            actual_checksum="$(sha256sum "$asset_path" | awk '{ print $1 }')"
          else
            actual_checksum="$(shasum -a 256 "$asset_path" | awk '{ print $1 }')"
          fi

          if [ "$actual_checksum" != "$expected_checksum" ]; then
            echo "::error::Checksum mismatch for ${asset_name}"
            exit 1
          fi

          rm -rf "$install_root" "$install_bin"
          mkdir -p "$install_root" "$install_bin"

          if [ "$asset_ext" = "zip" ]; then
            unzip -q "$asset_path" -d "$install_root"
          else
            tar -xzf "$asset_path" -C "$install_root"
          fi

          extracted_binary="$(find "$install_root" -type f -name "$binary_name" | head -n 1)"
          if [ -z "$extracted_binary" ]; then
            echo "::error::Failed to locate ${binary_name} in extracted release archive"
            exit 1
          fi

          cp "$extracted_binary" "$install_bin/$binary_name"
          chmod +x "$install_bin/$binary_name"
          echo "$install_bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

      - name: Install repository dependencies
        if: inputs.install-command != ''
        shell: bash
        env:
          INSTALL_CMD: ${{ inputs.install-command }}
        working-directory: ${{ inputs.root }}
        run: $INSTALL_CMD

      - name: Resolve managed provenance paths
        id: paths
        shell: bash
        env:
          PROVENANCE_ROOT: ${{ inputs.root }}
        run: |
          root="${PROVENANCE_ROOT%/}"
          if [ -z "$root" ] || [ "$root" = "." ]; then
            add_paths='provenance/**'
          else
            add_paths="$root/provenance/**"
          fi
          {
            echo "add_paths<<EOF"
            echo "$add_paths"
            echo "EOF"
          } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Generate provenance artifacts
        shell: bash
        env:
          INSTALL_SYFT: ${{ inputs.install-syft }}
          PROVENANCE_ROOT: ${{ inputs.root }}
          PROVENANCE_SYFT: ${{ steps.syft.outputs.cmd }}
        run: |
          provenance_cdxgen="$(command -v cdxgen)"
          export PROVENANCE_CDXGEN="$provenance_cdxgen"
          if [ "$INSTALL_SYFT" = "true" ]; then
            export PROVENANCE_SYFT
          else
            unset PROVENANCE_SYFT
          fi
          provenance generate --root "$PROVENANCE_ROOT"

      # Write credentials are minted only after every generator has run.
      - name: Mint App token
        id: app-token
        if: >-
          env.HAS_AUTH_TOKEN != 'true'
          && env.HAS_APP_CREDENTIALS == 'true'
        uses: actions/create-github-app-token@64ab729a6294000f5aa4a4bc0b73d1f32bc45510 # v3.3.0
        with:
          client-id: ${{ secrets.app_id }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.app_private_key }}
          owner: ${{ github.repository_owner }}
          repositories: ${{ github.event.repository.name }}

      - name: Checkout shared tooling
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v6
        with:
          repository: ${{ job.workflow_repository }}
          ref: ${{ job.workflow_sha }}
          path: .signed-commit
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Create refresh PR
        id: commit
        uses: ./.signed-commit/.github/actions/signed-commit
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.auth_token || steps.app-token.outputs.token || github.token }}
          mode: refresh-pr
          branch: ${{ inputs.branch }}
          base: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          paths: ${{ steps.paths.outputs.add_paths }}
          commit-message: ${{ inputs.commit-message }}
          pr-title: ${{ inputs.pr-title }}
          pr-body: ${{ inputs.pr-body }}

      - name: Report updater result
        shell: bash
        env:
          OPERATION: ${{ steps.commit.outputs.operation }}
          PR_URL: ${{ steps.commit.outputs.pull-request-url }}
        run: |
          case "$OPERATION" in
            created|updated)
              echo "Opened or updated provenance PR: $PR_URL"
              ;;
            closed)
              echo "Closed stale provenance PR because there are no remaining changes."
              ;;
            *)
              echo "No provenance changes detected."
              ;;
          esac
documents.actions/setup-bun-cached/action.yml:
name: Setup Bun with install cache
description: Install Bun and persist its global install cache keyed on bun.lock

inputs:
  bun-version-file:
    description: >-
      Version file forwarded to setup-bun. Pass an empty string to install
      the latest Bun instead of the pinned version.
    required: false
    default: package.json
  save:
    description: Save the install cache after the job; false restores only
    required: false
    default: "true"
  install-cache:
    description: >-
      Where ~/.bun/install/cache lives between jobs: actions moves it through
      the Actions cache; runner leaves it on a persistent self-hosted runner,
      which already keeps it. Ephemeral runners need actions.
    required: false
    default: actions

runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - name: Check install cache mode
      if: inputs.install-cache != 'actions' && inputs.install-cache != 'runner'
      shell: bash
      env:
        INSTALL_CACHE: ${{ inputs.install-cache }}
      run: |
        echo "::error::install-cache must be actions or runner, got '$INSTALL_CACHE'"
        exit 1

    - name: Setup Bun
      id: setup-bun
      uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@0c5077e51419868618aeaa5fe8019c62421857d6 # v2
      with:
        bun-version-file: ${{ inputs.bun-version-file }}

    - name: Restore Bun install cache
      # Caches downloaded package tarballs (~/.bun/install/cache), not
      # node_modules, so `bun ci` still resolves against the frozen lockfile
      # and only skips re-downloading unchanged packages.
      if: inputs.install-cache == 'actions' && inputs.save != 'false'
      uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
      with:
        path: ~/.bun/install/cache
        key: bun-install-${{ runner.os }}-${{ steps.setup-bun.outputs.bun-version }}-${{ hashFiles('bun.lock') }}
        restore-keys: |
          bun-install-${{ runner.os }}-${{ steps.setup-bun.outputs.bun-version }}-

    - name: Restore Bun install cache without saving
      if: inputs.install-cache == 'actions' && inputs.save == 'false'
      uses: actions/cache/restore@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
      with:
        path: ~/.bun/install/cache
        key: bun-install-${{ runner.os }}-${{ steps.setup-bun.outputs.bun-version }}-${{ hashFiles('bun.lock') }}
        restore-keys: |
          bun-install-${{ runner.os }}-${{ steps.setup-bun.outputs.bun-version }}-
